headline: 29 addresses catalogued on HyperEVM (Project X): 1 factory, 1 swap router, 1 position manager, 1 deployer EOA, WHYPE, and 25 factory-created contracts; no official docs, audits or GitHub found.

findings.text: HyperEVMScan (chain 999) carries public name tags for 'Project X: Swap Router' (0x1EbDFC75FfE3ba3de61E7138a3E8706aC841Af9B) and 'Project X: Factory' (0xFf7B3e8C00e57ea31477c32A5B52a58Eea47b072). The internal-transactions page also shows a 'Project X: Nonfungible Position Manager' tag at 0xeaD19AE861c29bBb2101E834922B2FEee69B9091. The NFPM was seen on a page for a different address, so its own page was not fetched. The explorer's tag search was not run directly. Addresses were found through search grounding and then fetched on the explorer.

No official 'Deployed contracts' page was found. https://www.prjx.com returned only a JS shell with Swap / Liquidity / Portfolio / Cashdrop links. The docs host was not fetchable because it had not appeared in any prior result.
No audit links are pinned. The explorer pages for the Router and Factory both show 'No Contract Security Audit Submitted'. No audit PDFs were found.

No official GitHub repo is recorded. A search surfaced github.com/kekeke29341/hyper_evm, a personal repo that describes itself as a Project X proxy-LP / frontend monorepo ('Hyperpool'). It is not evidenced as the official protocol repo, so it is not recorded as protocol_metadata.github. No deployment artifacts were read from it.

The only chain is Hyperliquid L1 (HyperEVM, chain id 999), and all addresses are recorded for it. The Router page's Blockscan panel shows the same address with balances on Base and Ethereum. Those chains are outside protocol.chains and were not investigated.

The Factory is a verified UniswapV3Factory (Solidity 0.7.6) with 79 transactions. Its page lists 25 'Contract Creation' internal transactions, which are likely pools. These 25 are recorded as tentative pool children, below the 50-child cap. The factory's getPool / allPools enumeration was not run, because defipunkd surfacer URLs for non-pinned addresses are rejected.

Roles assigned from the controlled vocabulary: factory, router, other (position manager), token (WHYPE), other (deployer), pool (tentative). actor_class is 'unknown' for all, because no bytecode or Safe reads were possible. The Factory ABI exposes owner(), setOwner() and enableFeeAmount(), but the owner value was not read.

Every address in admin_addresses traces to a fetched explorer page: the Router page, the Factory page, or the 0x5bf2…54f1 internal-tx page. Addresses seen only in search snippets are placed in unknowns[].

rationale.verdict: Discovery only: walked the website, 3 HyperEVMScan pages and 1 unverified GitHub repo; catalogued 29 addresses with 1 role-tentative admin surface (deployer EOA) and owner/timelock still unresolved.

evidence.shows: Official website (JS shell). Describes the product as 'Trade any coin in crypto with 0% fees' and links Swap, Liquidity, Portfolio and Cashdrop. It lists no contract addresses.

Public name tag 'Project X: Swap Router'. Verified SwapRouter (Solidity 0.7.6), flagged by the explorer as a Custom proxy whose implementation is itself. Constructor args decode to _factory=0xFf7B3e8C00e57ea31477c32A5B52a58Eea47b072 and _WETH9=0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555. Contract creator 0x09529ed21d0F908FE472DaDd8354CC3B24599BF6. No audit submitted.

Public name tag 'Project X: Factory'. Verified UniswapV3Factory with owner/setOwner/enableFeeAmount/createPool/getPool in its ABI. Created by 0x09529ed21d0F908FE472DaDd8354CC3B24599BF6. 79 transactions. The latest 25 internal transactions are 'Contract Creation' calls to 25 addresses (derived: likely pools).

Internal-transactions page for 0x5bf2366D…123E454F1. It contains the tag 'Project X: Nonfungible Position Manager' at 0xeaD19AE861c29bBb2101E834922B2FEee69B9091 and the tag 'Hyperliquid: WHYPE Token' at 0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555. The role of 0x5bf2…54f1 itself is not shown.

Personal repo described as 'Project X DEX frontend and contracts for HyperEVM' / 'Hyperpool (Project X Proxy LP)'. It lists chain IDs 998 and 999. Provenance as the official repo is not established, so it is not used for metadata.

unknowns: D1: Direct explorer name-tag search (hyperevmscan.io/searchHandler) was not attempted. Discovery relied on search grounding plus fetched address pages. Additional 'Project X'-tagged contracts may exist, e.g. QuoterV2, UniversalRouter, token-descriptor, multicall, fee-collector or treasury contracts.

D2: No official deployed-contracts / docs page found. https://docs.prjx.com could not be fetched, because the URL had not appeared in any prior result. protocol_metadata.deployed_contracts_doc is left null.
D3: No audit reports recorded in protocol.audit_links or surfaced by search or explorer pages.

D4: No official GitHub repo or deployment artifact (broadcast / deployments / addresses.json) confirmed. The kekeke29341/hyper_evm repo is of unverified provenance and was not walked at a pinned commit SHA.
D5: Router address also shows balances on Base and Ethereum per Blockscan. Those chains are outside protocol.chains, and whether they are official deployments is unknown.

D6: Factory 0xFf7B3e8C…b072 children enumeration via getPool / pool lists was not run, because the defipunkd read API rejected a non-pinned address (allowlist: only URLs from the context or prior fetches). The 25 factory-created contracts come from the explorer's latest-25 internal tx list only. The full pool set (79 factory txs, the rest of the pools) is not enumerated. Whether these 25 are actually pools is unverified.

D7: Factory owner() value, Swap Router proxy/implementation upgradability and NFPM ownership were not read. actor_class is 'unknown' for all entries. 0x09529ed21d0F908FE472DaDd8354CC3B24599BF6 is only the creator of the Router and Factory, and whether it is an EOA or still holds any privilege is unknown.
D7: Control-surface contracts (timelock, multisig, owner, fee collector, treasury) have not been identified at all.

D8: 0x5bf2366d2591f75ade949727baf197c123e454f1 was seen as the subject of a fetched internal-tx page (it received HYPE from the NFPM, WHYPE, KyberSwap, LI.FI and HyperSwap contracts), but its role was not established. It is not recorded in admin_addresses.

D8: The Swap Router explorer page shows many user EOAs and 'Hyburn: Deployer' (0xDB69a37a2dF11524FAd05239A42921CA604BE75B) calling the Factory, which are pool-creation callers rather than protocol admins. They are not recorded.

D2-offchain: Direct fetches of https://www.prjx.com returned only a JS shell with no addresses. Attempted fetch of defipunkd /api/contract/read for the Router (method=factory) was rejected by the allowlist (not a pinned surfacer). No on-chain state reads (owner, getPool, proxy slots) were obtained via the defipunkd API in this run.

protocol_metadata: docs_url, audits, governance_forum, voting_token, bug_bounty_url and security_contact were not found or verified. upgradeability is left unknown, because the explorer labels the Router a 'Custom proxy' pointing at itself without an upgrade mechanism being shown.

protocol_metadata.about: Project X is a swap and liquidity venue on Hyperliquid's HyperEVM; its website advertises trading with 0% fees. On-chain, the tagged Factory is a verified UniswapV3Factory and the Swap Router and position manager follow the Uniswap V3 periphery design, so liquidity providers deposit into concentrated-liquidity pools and traders swap through the router (derived from the explorer ABIs and source, not from official docs).
